newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel sees hike in hardwood pulp price.
newsitem.headline: Portucel sees hike in hardwood pulp price.

text.p: Portuguese pulp company Portucel Industrial-Empresa Produtora de Celulose expects to raise its hardwood pulp price by about 40 ecus per tonne to 460 ecus per tonne in October, an official source said.
"Market conditions exist for an increase in prices in October, probably to around 460 ecus per tonne," the source told Reuters.
Portucel fixed its hardwood pulp price at 420 ecus per tonne in July.
The source added: "This increase would be equivalent to the increase in softwood prices announced by various companies in the pulp sector today."
Some Scandinavian softwood pulp producers, including Sodra Cel and Enso, today announced price increases of about $50 to $630 per tonne, effective from October.
The source said: "The market is receptive to an increase in pulp prices."
He added: "Prospects for sales and orders are encouraging and indicate that the second half will be considerably better than the first."
Portucel was steady at 1,029 escudos in volume of 196,330 shares at 1527 GMT.
